_about: Category rules for whoseware. Each tag on an entity records WHY (the sentence, the list's own definition, or the source link). Keyword matches are case-insensitive and start at a word boundary ('racis' matches 'racist'). Edit here, not in the code; 'suppress' removes a wrong tag, 'add' adds a sourced one. 'suppress' entries say why; they never remove a tag added by hand in 'add'.

fascism.title: Fascism / far right
fascism.description: dictatorial or authoritarian politics, far-right movements, 'dark enlightenment' and neoreaction

racism.title: Racism
racism.description: racism, antisemitism, white-supremacist and ethno-nationalist views or funding

militarism.title: Militarism
militarism.description: arms makers, war profiteering, military and border-enforcement contracting, advocacy of war

surveillance.title: Surveillance
surveillance.description: mass surveillance, spyware, face recognition, data brokering

ultracapitalism.title: Ultracapitalism
ultracapitalism.description: billionaires, and companies with serious labour-law violations (the wealth and penalty data arrive in a later release; for now only what the lists say)

misconduct.title: Misconduct
misconduct.description: harassment, abuse, fraud, rug-pulls and similar conduct
